title: add mistral-7b v0.1 to model-registry + performance profiles + changelog automation
author: Marco Rivera
body: Context: Add initial onboarding for mistral-7b v0.1 into the model registry. This includes canonical metadata, versioning tags, performance profiles for supported GPU families, recommended quantization profiles, automated changelog/release-notes generation workflow, minimal docs, and an e2e test that validates metadata and profile application. Motivation: customers and internal teams requested a verified Mistral baseline for benchmarking and as a fall back model in routing policies. This PR also introduces a GitHub Actions workflow that auto-generates a model-registry changelog entry when model metadata or profile files change; the changelog can be used by release automation and the Console to show recent model updates. Checklist: [x] Add metadata YAML and manifest; [x] Add performance_profile JSON with microbenchmarks; [x] Add quantization recommendations; [x] Add e2e smoke test; [x] Add docs page under docs/models; [x] Add changelog GH Action and template; [x] Update unit/eval harness references; [x] Run CI and perf lab smoke runs. Changes are intentionally small and isolated under model-registry and infra/ci workflows. See related Linear items ENG-2345 and ENG-2399 for rollout plan and perf validation notes.
commits: initial add: metadata and basic profile for mistral-7b v0.1
ci: add changelog generator workflow for model-registry
perf: add throughput/latency profiles for A100 and T4 GPU families
tests: add e2e smoke test for model metadata/registration
docs: add docs page with recommended configs and migration notes
review_comments: Anya Patel: Can you include the representative dataset used for the latency microbenchmarks? Also please add the hardware setup in the comment of the performance_profile.json.

Marco Rivera (author): Added dataset reference and hardware note inline in performance_profile.json. Kept the datasets as internal artifact references (perf-lab/benchsets/mistral-v0) per infra policy.

Leo Martinez: Two nits on metadata fields: please add 'safety_review: pending' and include a short 'intended_use' field. Also recommend adding a quick note in docs about fallback routing when this model is out of capacity.
Marco Rivera: Added 'safety_review: pending' and 'intended_use: research and latency-sensitive fallback' to metadata.yaml; added routing note in docs.
Sofia Chen: CI flakes observed on first run due to a timing dependency in tests; recommend a retry or small sleep in the smoke test. Approving pending that change.
Marco Rivera: Pushed fix to tests to make the e2e smoke test resilient to transient registry delays (simple polling with timeout). CI passed on rerun.
Anya Patel: Verified perf numbers against perf-lab dashboard; numbers look reasonable. Approving for merge.
release_notes: Added Mistral-7B v0.1 to model registry with metadata, GPU performance profiles (A100/T4), quantization recommendations, and automated changelog generation for model metadata changes. Intended as verified baseline for latency-sensitive fallbacks and benchmarking. NOTE: safety_review is pending (follow ENG-2399).
